positions.name: KnowledgeDeletionDirectives
positions.frame: what is being asserted when an instruction commands that a named decision or body of knowledge be forgotten or removed from the record?
positions.why: Both expressions are imperative directives from the same speaker, issued back-to-back in the same flat, matter-of-fact register, each naming a concrete target (a decision; a migration) and commanding an irrealis state-change over what the collective retains. The relational and power reads agree across both (authority-ranking, legitimate/informational), and conviction reads both as settled instruction rather than exploration — the pair coheres as a single directional move: exercising authority to determine what persists in the record. No tension to hold; the two differ only in target, not in stance.
